examples.english: one gets sad and in a bad mood and a mighty big melancholy comes over them
examples.ref: 1970, Juan Marsé, Esta cara de la luna:
examples.text: uno se pone triste y de mal humor y le entra una melancolía de tres pares de narices
examples.translation: one gets sad and in a bad mood and a mighty big melancholy comes over them

examples.english: They had a mighty big argument, of the history-defining type. He threatened to kick him out of the house.
examples.ref: 2004, Pedro García García, En agosto del 77 nacías tú:
examples.text: Tuvieron una discusión de tres pares de narices, de las que hacen historia. Le volvió a amenazar con echarlo de casa.
examples.translation: They had a mighty big argument, of the history-defining type. He threatened to kick him out of the house.

examples.english: Girl, there's no-one like you. You make a hell of a scene, you get away with it scot-free, and on top of everything you score.
examples.ref: 2014, Maya Ruibarbo, Crónicas de una parada desquiciada:
examples.text: Tía, eres de lo que no hay. Montas un pollo de tres pares de narices, te sales de rositas, y encima ligas.
examples.translation: Girl, there's no-one like you. You make a hell of a scene, you get away with it scot-free, and on top of everything you score.

glosses: whopping great; a helluva (used to make emphatic)
